purpose: Evidence-led consolidation register. This file is a working map, not authorization to delete, rename, repurpose, or dual-write database objects.

database_authority.rule: Website, Notion and Airtable are read projections/mirrors; they must not become competing write authorities.

limitations: Counts are a point-in-time staging observation.
Table existence and non-empty rows do not prove a working user journey.
No destructive consolidation is approved by this inventory alone.
